title: Overhaul Android dependency packaging and isolate production sources
scope: Major packaging overhaul implemented and verified, including the user-requested QML-tooling policy. User accepted closure and requested commit on 2026-11-04.
finding: Android APKs contain the Qt Virtual Keyboard native library and platform input-context plugin even though the app's desktop keyboard loader is disabled and its QML module has no Virtual Keyboard dependency.
evidence: The existing dist/QShopper-x86_64-debug.apk and fresh out/dev004/android-x86 APK both contain libQt6VirtualKeyboard_x86_64.so (466304 bytes) and libplugins_platforminputcontexts_qtvirtualkeyboardplugin_x86_64.so (14496 bytes). Their contents are byte-identical between those APKs.
The previous ARM64 APK also contains the corresponding native libraries.

The fresh Android build explicitly requests QSHOPPER_DESKTOP_KEYBOARD=ON to verify the platform override: the generated loader source is empty and qmldir has no Virtual Keyboard dependency. This preserves the runtime native-keyboard configuration.
An initial package audit assumed these files should be absent; baseline comparison showed the payload predates DEV-004. Treat this as a packaging investigation, not a new build-cleanup regression.
expected: Determine whether the native payload is required by Qt deployment or can be excluded cleanly while retaining Android's system IME and the desktop development keyboard.
implementation_notes: Trace androiddeployqt, QML import scanning and platform-input-context plugin dependencies before identifying a cause; no particular scanner or source file is proven responsible.
Keep any supported exclusion KISS and confined to Android. Avoid post-build deletion workarounds without establishing the actual dependency chain.

Characterize the intended deployment contract before treating library presence as a bug. If removing it is appropriate, add a repeatable APK-content check and verify fresh packages for both shipped ABIs.
Verify real Gboard entry, retained keyboard on Return, hide/reopen and native Back with isolated emulator data; keep desktop keyboard builds/tests working.
Coordinate the actual shipped-dependency inventory with release preparation and About notices.
acceptance_criteria: Document the dependency path and decide whether the libraries are required or unnecessary payload.
If an exclusion is justified, implement it separately with package-content and native-IME verification; otherwise document why the payload remains.

ui023_payload_observation.finding: Fresh UI-023 Android packages still contain Canvas2D and CanvasPainter libraries despite removal of explicit QML/module/link usage. Inventory the actual APK; the deployment dependency/scan path has not been established. No packaging change is included in UI-023.

user_scope_expansion: I'm pretty sure that APK contains other unused libraries too. Combine the scope and do a major overhaul.
confirmed_causes: Qt Gui default plugin deployment selected QVirtualKeyboardPlugin even without an app VirtualKeyboard link. Its native dependency pulls in Qt6VirtualKeyboard.

Qt 6.12 Android QML deployment recursively scans source directories collected from the app target and linked QML modules. The root layout included tests and old in-tree builds. A resource-only scan has no Canvas imports; the actual broad scan finds QtCanvas2D/QtCanvasPainter in historical UndoIcon copies.

Generic QtQuick.Controls imports bring optional Imagine, Universal and FluentWinUI3 styles through the Qt qmldir; the app already selects Material, while the editor intentionally uses Fusion.TextField.

Default Qt plugins add unused image/vector formats, an offscreen platform, optional TLS/network-information providers and a 3D profiler adapter. The current app has JPEG/local PNG assets, SQLite data and a native Android IME.
implementation: Move the 48 production C++/QML/asset/template files into app/ and declare the app/module there. Root CMake handles project setup and tests. Keep QShopper URI, resource aliases and Windows executable/QML output locations stable. Build outputs stay outside app/.
Use explicit Material imports for production controls, preserving the Fusion text field and Qt Basic fallback. Retain QQuickStyle::setStyle(Material) for third-party desktop keyboard compatibility.

Use qt_import_plugins on Android to select the native platform, JPEG and SQLite and exclude unused providers/formats/3D profiling. Keep Qt Quick native dependency closure, required styles with QML tooling only on explicit development opt-in; Release/MinSizeRel exclude it. Desktop Virtual Keyboard remains enabled under its existing gate.

Update build-android.ps1 for app/ build products and optional -VerifyPackage/-Python checking. Add -Jobs to bound build concurrency. Update model coverage source roots and live documentation/review links.

regression.before: Original UI-023 ARM64 APK fails with 41 unexpected libraries and repository-wide QML roots (out/dev008/final-before-arm64.json/log). Both original ABIs were inventoried before changes.
regression.after: Final default APKs for both ABIs pass, Release forced-debug remains tooling-free, and explicit Debug tooling opt-in passes its matching contract. ELF dependencies and QML scan roots verified. See final verification artifacts.
regression.integration: build-android.ps1 -VerifyPackage runs the checker after packaging/signing; optional Python 3 is required only for that switch.

verification.windows: out/dev008/windows-verify.log: all five suites pass; 331 records including desktop Virtual Keyboard and native rendering. Final CMake safety/tooling changes also pass Windows configure/build.
verification.analysis: out/dev008/analysis.log: clang-tidy and Clazy pass all six tracked translation units (12 runs) after relocation. C++/asset byte hashes remain unchanged.
verification.android: out/dev008/android-entry/results.json: 28 native Gboard/editor/drawer/Back/catalog/restart checks pass. out/dev008/android-undo/results.json: 22 native Undo checks pass in both themes. After disabling QML tooling, out/dev008/no-tooling-android/results.json adds 12 passes on the actual no-tooling APK, including launch, Gboard entry, batch restoration, expiry and resume. All use unique emulator-only data.
verification.packages: Final signed default ARM64 and x86_64 APKs pass tests/test_android_package.py, including ELF closure, no unwanted payload/tooling and app-only scan roots: final-arm64-package.json and final-x86-package.json.
verification.qml_tooling_matrix: Release ARM64 built with QT_ENABLE_QML_DEBUG=ON still excludes all tooling and the application compiler define; explicit Debug opt-in contains the tooling and compiler define. Public helper -QmlDebug then default build both pass packaging checks, proving incremental opt-out removes stale files.
verification.format: All 57 QML/templates and nine C++ files pass repository formatter checks; git diff --check passes.
verification.resource_compatibility: QML resource URI/alias sets match the pre-overhaul build. Production C++/assets retain their original byte hashes.

qml_tooling_request.request: User questioned QML tooling libraries in Debug APKs and explicitly wants them absent from Release.
qml_tooling_request.policy: Default Debug omits QML tooling; explicit Qt QT_ENABLE_QML_DEBUG opt-in (build helper -QmlDebug) retains it only for development configurations. Release/MinSizeRel exclude plugins and turn off the target setting even if requested ON.
qml_tooling_request.incremental_finding: Qt androiddeployqt leaves obsolete native libraries in existing staging directories. Disabling the plugins alone failed the actual APK regression. Reconfigure now safely regenerates only the generated Android staging directory; no post-package file deletion.
qml_tooling_request.validation: Default Debug APKs for both ABIs pass no-tooling checks; explicit Debug opt-in contains 12 tooling plugins. Release ARM64 requested QT_ENABLE_QML_DEBUG=ON but APK contains none and the application compiler flag is absent. Incremental opt-out initially failed on stale native files; staging regeneration makes it pass.

resolution.acceptance: User requested ticket closure and commit on 2026-11-04. No physical-phone verification is claimed.
resolution.summary: Production-only QML scanning and explicit Android plugin/style selection reduce the ARM64 APK from 95.6 MB to 63.1 MB and native libraries from 103 to 45. QML tooling is an explicit Debug opt-in and always excluded from Release/MinSizeRel. Safe staging regeneration prevents obsolete libraries surviving incremental builds.
resolution.regression: tests/test_android_package.py rejects the original payload and passes both final ABIs, Release and explicit Debug opt-in. Windows, analyzers and isolated native Android checks pass as recorded above.
resolution.remaining: None in the accepted packaging scope. About notices and publication preparation remain separate under UI-012 and REL-001.

result.artifact_note: The existing dist/QShopper-arm64-debug.apk is locked by another process. A separately named final APK was signed and verified with the shared key; the canonical file was left intact. The normal helper output name remains unchanged.
